pages.text: You have discovered a new type of fungus. By processing Warped Fungus with a Lily of the Valley in a Brewing Stand, you realized that the resulting blue fungus is highly unstable—simply throwing it causes it to explode, leaving behind a large pool of acid that deals sustained damage to creatures.
Of course, for certain arcane reasons, the acid produced by the Acid Fungus does not affect you or your servants.
